- [ ] Add proxy integration coverage for the actual 127.0.0.1 deployment case and any internal/external URL mismatch; keep router token server-only.
- [ ] Make the existing A/B success cases pass on desktop/mobile; the unrelated strict-locator failures remain tracked in QA-02.
- [ ] Document the distinction from the unavailable historical reports and record before/after status evidence.
